card.name: Linking words in search and database descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as on, a, the, via and 's inside descriptions of software products, especially Solr, Cassandra and search or database systems. It also fires on some formal legal or technical phrases.

modes.label: Software product descriptions
modes.description: A preposition or article that follows a verb or noun in a sentence describing how Solr, Cassandra or similar tools work or combine.
modes.example: which integrates Solr search indices<< on>> data stored in Cassandra.

modes.label: Formal legal or statistical phrases
modes.description: A small linking word inside a formal title or technical phrase, just before a noun.
modes.example: the Act respecting the protection of personal information in<< the>> private sector.

card.plain: It marks little linking words in text describing search engines and databases, where a technical noun comes next.
